claims.statement: The subsidy gate is real and model-specific: qualifying heat pumps must be listed on the invoice date.
The legal access dependency is obtainable but customer-bound: the official workflow permits manufacturers or manufacturer-authorised entities, and listing is free.
Report interpretation is non-trivial because accredited test reports contain prescribed methods, measured values, identifiers, and accreditation details that must remain internally consistent.
Rule simplification and recognised quality marks reduce evidence burden for several categories, while air-to-water laboratory testing remains material.
The 2025 EPREL update campaign documented thousands of incomplete records and suspension risk, establishing episodic reconciliation pain.
EPREL already gives suppliers registration workflows and exposes public model information and APIs, so basic record access is not a defensible product moat.
Adjacent Polish providers already prepare documentation and register products in EPREL, creating a direct substitute for part of the proposed service.
Laboratory and distributor referrals can lower acquisition cost enough for a part-time founder.
Suppliers will pay a monthly monitoring fee after their current model families are accepted.

contrary_evidence: Official placement is free and suppliers can use the List ZUM workflow directly.
Several heat-pump categories gained simpler evidence routes through recognised European quality marks.
EPREL already offers supplier guidance, generated artefacts, public records, and API access.
An adjacent Polish laboratory/compliance provider already offers documentation checking and EPREL registration.
No gathered source provides recurring-service pricing, rejection rates, or customer retention evidence.
